title: One coherent Vue web and Capacitor application

acceptance.expected: One shared Vue shell and real feature components preserve suitcase, archive, administration and deep-link journeys across web and Capacitor; telemetry preserves focus and stale physical intent is invalidated.

Persistent controlled owner enrollment, passkey sign-in, invitations, recovery, session revocation and resource grants are enforced server-side with CSRF and privilege separation; guest and device capabilities remain independent.

Application build and viewer tests require no CAD toolchain or manufacturing artifact; validated immutable ModelBundles and the same maintained offline viewer compose independently and work through file URLs without network.

Supported native passkey authentication, Keychain session and existing physical BLE pairing survive app resume and user switching; actual associated-domain and signed-device requirements are verified separately from synthetic web evidence.

blockers.problem: Signed iPhone associated-domain passkeys, Keychain resume/switching, actual native public/media behavior and physical BLE possession are not yet accepted; macOS native software checks passed.
blockers.unblockCondition: Verify those behaviors on the authorized signed iPhone installation against the canonical HTTPS associated domain and the physical suitcase; retain the successful macOS CI software evidence.

nextAction: Verify signed iPhone associated-domain passkeys, Keychain resume/switching, native public model/media and physical pairing on the authorized installation. Source handoff uses PR218 CI/review gates; production activation remains separate.
